capabilities: highlight ABAL code blocks in Live Preview and Source mode
highlight ABAL code blocks in reading mode via a post-processor
colorize ABAL keywords, strings, comments, numbers, operators and punctuation
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian's built-in code block highlighting does not cover the ABAL programming language, so ABAL snippets display as plain text.
summary: Syntax highlighter that renders ABAL language code blocks in edit and reading modes.
